commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing
cat > bin/deliver <<'ANTRIEB_DELIVER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool_dir="$base/Maildir/tmp"
mkdir -p "$spool_dir"
message=$(mktemp "$spool_dir/deliver.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$message"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

cat > "$message"

department=$(
  awk '
    /^\r?$/ { exit }
    /^[ \t]/ { next }
    {
      line = $0
      sub(/\r$/, "", line)
      colon = index(line, ":")
      if (colon == 0) {
        next
      }
      name = tolower(substr(line, 1, colon - 1))
      if (name == "x-department") {
        value = substr(line, colon + 1)
        sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", value)
        sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", value)
        print tolower(value)
        exit
      }
    }
  ' "$message"
)

case "$department" in
  accounts) mailbox=accounts ;;
  support) mailbox=support ;;
  *) mailbox=general ;;
esac

destination="$base/Maildir/$mailbox/new"
mkdir -p "$destination"
filename=${message##*/}
mv "$message" "$destination/$filename"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_DELIVER_EOF
chmod 755 bin/deliver
sh -n bin/deliver
ls -l bin/deliver
sed -n '1,240p' bin/deliver

set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing
bin/deliver < samples/accounts.eml
bin/deliver < samples/support.eml
bin/deliver < samples/general.eml
bin/deliver < samples/general.eml
printf '%s\n' '--- DELIVERED FILES ---'
find Maildir -path '*/new/*' -type f -print | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- DELIVERED HASHES ---'
find Maildir -path '*/new/*' -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- COUNTS ---'
for box in accounts support general; do count=$(find "Maildir/$box/new" -type f | wc -l); printf '%s %s\n' "$box" "$count"; done
printf '%s\n' '--- STAGED SAMPLES STILL PRESENT ---'
sha256sum samples/*.eml
wc -c samples/*.eml
printf '%s\n' '--- TEMP SPOOL EMPTY ---'
find Maildir/tmp -type f -print
